title: BAKING CUPAVCI / LAMINGTONS - TRAVEL VLOG 367 AMSTERDAM | ENTERPRISEME TV
description:
I'm baking cupavci or better known as lamingtons in English! Cupavci are my favorite Yugoslavian/Balkan childhood cakes. Baking also happens to make me calm as I'm not feeling all too joyful at the beginning to this vlog. Hope you enjoy this baking cupavci travel vlog but DON'T click the following link: http://bit.ly/1KKCs8V (you just might be stuck with me by subscribing)
If you're on a roll here's a travel vlog with a dinner date with Mascha and Coco: https://youtu.be/y16UN7xYGwo

The recipe I used for the cupavci: https://youtu.be/a7hXQ7lYbGs

EnterpriseMe TV is a travel vlog channel. I'm Ivana, nice to meet you! I travel and make daily travel vlogs so you can travel without even leaving your couch or spending a dime. Subscribe if you want to travel with me! 

When I'm not traveling you can hang out with me in my home town Amsterdam. So if you always wanted to travel in Amsterdam this is the place to be to get an insight in the local life without actually having to travel. Enjoy!
